## How to Use This Document

- **Ctrl+F** to search for the exact message text a user reports
- Each entry shows: the exact file path, line number, full message, and purpose
- **IsDebug=Yes** messages only appear in Debug builds (internal/dev use)
- **Dynamic** messages contain variable data (e.g., error codes) - search by the static part
- The PrevCtx column shows the code line just before the message to help understand the trigger
